Non-Health Care Facility Point of Origin (Physician Referral): The patient was admitted to
this facility upon an order of a physician.

Clinic referral: The patient was admitted upon the recommendation of this facility’s clinic
physician.

was admitted upon the recommendation of a health maintenance organization (HMO)
physician.

Transfer from a hospital (different facility): The patient was admitted to this facility as a
hospital transfer from an acute care facility where he or she was an inpatient.

Transfer from a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or Intermediate Care Facility (ICF): The
patient was admitted to this facility as a transfer from a SNF or ICF where he or she was a
resident.

Transfer from another health care facility: The patient was admitted to this facility as a
transfer from another type of health care facility not defined elsewhere in this code list
where he or she was an inpatient.

Emergency room: The patient was admitted to this facility after receiving services in this
facility’s emergency room.

upon the request of a law enforcement agency’s representative.

agency as a transfer from another home health agency. (Discontinued July 1, 2010 – See
Condition Code 47)

health agency within the same home health episode period. (Discontinued July 1, 2010)

Normal delivery – A baby delivered without complications. Invalid for discharges after
12/31/2011.

Premature delivery – A baby delivered with time and/or weight factors qualifying it for
premature status. Invalid for discharges after 12/31/2011.

Sick baby – A baby delivered with medical complications, other than those relating to
premature status. Invalid for discharges after 12/31/2011.

Extramural birth – A baby delivered in a non-sterile environment. Invalid for discharges
after 12/31/2011.
